messages:
Kevin H.: Quick ask — can we run a small SI micro-credential pilot next Wed? Goal: a short hands-on lab, a digital badge on completion, and a marketplace sandbox listing. Need owners for curriculum, infra, and co-marketing.

Katie P.: I can own curriculum. lean plan: 3 mini-modules (marketplace deploy, perf tuning, ops/SLOs) + short auto-quiz to gate the badge.

Raj S.: Infra OK. I will build a marketplace sandbox bundle. Need final GPU choices and session caps. Suggest A10g for parity and 3-hour vouchers. If specs locked today I can have images up by Tue.

Mina L.: Ill do partner assets (one-pager, blurb, webinar page) and the joint email. Also want a 3-question feedback form + NPS post-lab.

Kevin H.: We need an automated eval to make badges meaningful. Katie, what passing bar?

Katie P.: For pilot: complete all 3 modules + 80% on automated eval. Keep it simple and measurable; we can raise the threshold later.

Raj S.: Eval harness is ready. Infra test command to run once sandbox is up:
```
./eval/run.sh --suite si-microcred-v1 --partner "$PARTNER" --voucher "$VOUCHER"
```
Outputs a `results.json` with score and pass boolean.

Leah B.: Quick legal note: co-marketing covered by MSA but logos require partner sign-off. Send partner list and Ill route to brand/legal.

Kevin H.: Action list (owners):
- Katie P. -> finalize curriculum + eval rubric and upload lab notebooks
- Raj S. -> create marketplace images + voucher mechanism
- Mina L. -> draft co-marketing assets + schedule webinar
- Leah B. -> partner logo approvals checklist

Raj S.: Katie, please drop the prompt seed and testset in the repo so I can wire the tickets.

Katie P.: Will push `si-microcred/prompts/testset.json` and `scripts/seed_prompts.sh` tonight.

deploy-bot: Event created: "SI Micro-credential Pilot - Dry Run" on 2026-03-25 09:30-10:30 (owner Kevin H.) :calendar:

Mina L.: I'll embed the short feedback form in the webinar follow-up and collect NPS.

Kevin H.: Quick sync tomorrow 9:00am for 15m to validate infra + rubric. Thanks team :rocket:
